_: Every control's default bindings, one table (Ed, 2026-10-28: "make it easy to manage and remap keys. We'll have a game settings menu where the player can do this"; src/platform/bindings.ts reads it, docs/notes/run.md **Controls**). Each action: its context (game: in play; menu: a station's panel, the sea chart, the telescope, the Studio; global: both), a plain name and what it does, and its keys (KeyboardEvent.code), mouse buttons (left, right, middle, wheelUp, wheelDown) and pad inputs (the standard pad's buttons by their PlayStation names: cross, circle, square, triangle, L1, R1, L2, R2, share, options, L3, R3, up, down, left, right (the d-pad), home; and the sticks' directions, lsUp ... rsRight). A player's own bindings are kept over these (localStorage witch.bindings). Ed's pad layout, 2026-10-28: the left stick moves, the right aims; cross uses and chooses ("do it"), circle dodges and goes back, square rises or lands and nothing else, triangle the hat, R1 and L1 cycle the stack, either trigger invites, L3 the boost, the d-pad's up and down zoom, Options pauses. dev: a playtest key, left off the controls list.

game.moveUp.name: Move up
game.moveUp.about: Fly or walk up the screen.

game.moveDown.name: Move down
game.moveDown.about: Fly or walk down the screen.

game.aimUp.name: Aim up
game.aimUp.about: Aim the 💌 up the screen (with the mouse: the cursor aims).

game.rise.name: Rise / land
game.rise.about: Rise to the treetops, or land. Nothing else (Ed: "rising is not quite a free action").

game.use.name: Use
game.use.about: Use what's here: open a station, take a rune, put down or pick up a sigil. Held: a run, picking up or putting down as she goes.

game.invite.name: Invite 💌
game.invite.about: Throw 💌 invites where she aims (held: keep throwing).

game.cycleNext.name: Next sigil
game.cycleNext.about: Cycle the stack: the bottom sigil (the next put down) to the top.

game.cyclePrev.name: Previous sigil
game.cyclePrev.about: Cycle the stack back: the top sigil to the bottom.

game.hat.name: Hat
game.hat.about: Put her hat down, or pick one up (on the keyboard: hold Use with nothing to do).

game.boost.name: Broom spell
game.boost.about: Her broom's spell, if it has one (the boost, the ley jump, the ground pound).

game.autoTalk.name: Auto-talk
game.autoTalk.about: Turn auto-talk on or off (off, she talks while Talk is held).

game.talk.name: Talk
game.talk.about: With auto-talk off, she talks while this is held.

game.nextWave.name: Next wave
game.nextWave.about: Playtest: bring the next wave now.

game.pauseWaves.name: Pause waves
game.pauseWaves.about: Playtest: pause or resume the waves' timer.

game.cycleSpeakers.name: Cycle speakers
game.cycleSpeakers.about: Debug: every speaker on to its next state.

game.feedNearest.name: Feed nearest
game.feedNearest.about: Debug: the nearest party animal eats a berry.

game.happyNearest.name: Cheer nearest
game.happyNearest.about: Debug: the nearest creature happy at once.

global.pause.name: Pause
global.pause.about: Pause everything (a still for screenshots, with a stamp of where you are).

menu.left.name: Menu left
menu.left.about: Move the highlight left (on a slider: less).

menu.right.name: Menu right
menu.right.about: Move the highlight right (on a slider: more).

menu.choose.name: Choose
menu.choose.about: Choose what's highlighted (at the sea chart: sail).

menu.back.name: Back
menu.back.about: Go back, or close the menu.

menu.zoomIn.name: Menu zoom in
menu.zoomIn.about: Zoom the sea chart or the telescope in.

menu.zoomOut.name: Menu zoom out
menu.zoomOut.about: Zoom the sea chart or the telescope out.
